title: AI-Brains codex-hook payload
description: JSON payload passed to `ai-brains codex-hook --payload`. Live path ingests `prompt` (UserPromptSubmit) and/or `lastAssistantMessage` (Stop) after T234 message-only filter. Does not parse transcript_path. Mid-payload garbage (invalid JSON) exits 1 with JSON; missing fields exit 0 with no ingest. Feature key is `hooks` (not `codex_hooks`).

sessionId.description: Codex session id (UUID preferred). Used for delta-sync and turn-id namespace.

projectHash.description: Normalized cwd path or `codex-unbound` when unbound. Alias key via ai-brains-path.

prompt.description: UserPromptSubmit prompt text. Empty/whitespace skips the user role (exit 0).

lastAssistantMessage.description: Stop last assistant text. Empty/whitespace skips the assistant role (exit 0).

cwd.description: Optional working directory; used for projectHash when the wrapper did not set it.

turnId.description: Optional Codex turn_id; preferred in live turn-id `{event}:{turn_id}`.

uuid.description: Optional record uuid (accepted for parity with Claude payload).
